source_snapshot.procedure: Use BMC WebUI Settings → SSL Settings → Generate Certificate Management; the SSL certificate key changes; view that the certificate matches modified settings; generic setup says clear logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Result is human readable and BMC Web login succeeds.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL conflates Generate with upload, requests user-supplied certificate material, guesses a Redfish path, uses insecure verification and only lists metadata; it does not prove BMC-side key generation, selected parameters, mode, activation or trusted WebUI recovery.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION with CRITICAL risk correctly requires owner parameters, secure key handling, pre/post identity baseline, bounded reconnect, served-chain validation, WebUI login and recovery.

old_problem: The source requires BMC-side certificate/key generation, but the earlier command substitutes upload/listing and never establishes whether this firmware creates an immediately active self-signed certificate or only an internal key plus CSR. Metadata appearance does not prove a new protected private key, active served identity or successful trusted login, and an irreversible key replacement can strand management access.
disposition_reason: Keep this row strictly on the WebUI Generate function and keep supplied-certificate Upload in row 926. Before execution, vendor documentation binds the exact mode: active self-signed generation or protected key-pair plus CSR. Both require one approved generation, new public-key/SPKI evidence, exact requested fields, private-key non-exportability, visual output and audit. Only active-generation mode may claim a changed served certificate; CSR-only mode must prove the active identity remains unchanged and cannot borrow upload coverage. The Project supplies parameters and recoverable access without reopening the engineering classification.
decision_basis: XLSX row 925, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, selection manifest, adjacent View/Upload rows and preserved V3.1 record were directly reviewed.
The source explicitly says Generate and key change, so upload is a non-equivalent adjacent testcase and cannot satisfy this row.
DMTF certificate actions distinguish key-pair/CSR generation and rekey behavior from certificate replacement; firmware mode and activation must be discovered and recorded before the one action.

A changed public key can be proven through CSR/certificate SPKI or fingerprint while the private key remains non-exportable. Recovery must exist before generation because metadata backup alone cannot restore a lost private key.

test_case.test_name: Generate a BMC-managed HTTPS key and certificate or CSR with mode-specific verification
test_case.purpose: Verify the target BMC WebUI Generate function performs its documented BMC-side key-generation mode exactly once with approved cryptographic and identity parameters, produces human-readable certificate/CSR evidence tied to a new protected key, maintains or restores trusted management access and never substitutes the separate upload workflow.
required_package: Exact BMC/firmware/WebUI/certificate-service identity and vendor-documented Generate mode: active self-signed certificate or key-pair plus CSR
Approved subject/common name, SAN set, organization fields, key algorithm/size or curve, signature algorithm, validity and target slot/role
Pre-change active certificate/chain/fingerprint/SPKI, complete slot state and documented activation/restart/reconnect behavior
Independent console/recovery management path plus an approved restorable known-good certificate/key package or vendor recovery method; metadata alone is insufficient
Project PKI/trust decision for generated self-signed identity or CSR signing flow, hostname and CA/reference bundle
Point-of-action approval, WebUI visual/audit capture, bounded reconnect and secret/private-key non-export handling
test_case.test_command: CRITICAL HTTPS IDENTITY/KEY CHANGE; DO NOT EXECUTE WITHOUT APPROVAL. Preserve logs and record the verified WebUI Generate capability, documented mode, target slot, current active chain/fingerprint/SPKI, recovery access and restorable identity. Validate all requested subject/SAN/crypto/validity fields and display them for approval. Invoke the exact WebUI Generate action once while capturing before/form/confirmation/audit evidence. If active self-signed mode, monitor bounded HTTPS/BMC reconnect, then verify a new active served SPKI/fingerprint, exact fields, hostname/validity/key-use and the explicitly approved trust outcome; log in through the approved path. If CSR-only mode, securely collect the public CSR, validate its subject/SAN/signature/public-key SPKI, prove the private key remains BMC-protected and prove the active served certificate/login remain unchanged; do not claim activation. Never upload material, export private keys, use `-k` as PASS, repeat generation or auto-retry.
test_case.expected_result: One new BMC-protected key pair is generated and the human-readable certificate or CSR exactly matches all approved fields and cryptographic policy. In active self-signed mode, the intended slot serves the new matching public identity after bounded reconnect and approved WebUI/API login succeeds under the documented trust policy. In CSR-only mode, the CSR verifies against the new SPKI while the previously active TLS identity and login remain intact until the separate signed-upload workflow. No other slot, key or certificate changes.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires documented mode, one audited WebUI Generate action, new public-key/SPKI evidence, exact field/crypto match, private-key non-exportability and mode-specific active/unmodified TLS plus WebUI-login proof. Certificate-list appearance, HTTP success, upload or `curl -k` cannot pass. Wrong fields/key, unexpected slot activation, hostname/trust failure, lost management access, missing CSR signature, private-key exposure or recovery failure is FAIL and stops. Missing mode, parameters, restorable identity, approval or recovery is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS.
safety_gate: Do not clear audit logs, upload a certificate, export/collect private keys, delete the old identity or reuse production key material.
Verify exact target, Generate mode, slot and parameter form from vendor documentation; do not guess Redfish/OEM actions.
Prove independent recovery and a restorable known-good identity before generation; certificate metadata alone is not rollback.
Obtain point-of-action approval for exactly one generation and monitor the documented reconnect bound without disabling trust verification.
Stop on unexpected activation, identity/trust mismatch or access loss; do not click Generate again or rotate/delete another slot automatically.
expected_evidence: Target/version identity, vendor-documented generation mode/slot/activation behavior, approved fields/crypto/trust and recovery authorization
Complete pre-change WebUI/API/served certificate roles, chain, fingerprint/SPKI and verified independent recovery/restorable identity
Visual Generate form/confirmation/result plus BMC audit event and one-action timestamp
Parsed generated certificate or CSR with subject/SAN/validity/key/signature and new public-key/SPKI proof without private-key material
Mode-specific served-certificate/reconnect and approved WebUI/API login evidence, or CSR-only proof that active TLS stayed unchanged
Unchanged unrelated slots, preserved logs, no upload/no retry/no private-key exposure and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong identity, unexpected activation, trust failure or management loss, stop further certificate actions and preserve audit/TLS evidence. Use the independent recovery channel and the pre-approved vendor procedure to restore the known-good certificate/key identity or documented prior slot only after fresh authorization, then revalidate served fingerprint, hostname trust and login. Never regenerate, delete or upload another certificate blindly.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require BMC-side generation, changed key, readable settings and successful login. Firmware generation mode is an explicit parameter, not a competing purpose, and Upload remains a separate row.

blocked.reason: Mode-specific Generate semantics, evidence and recovery are fully defined. Vendor mode, parameters, slot and trust package are Project execution inputs.
